critique: The garden metaphor creates strong visceral appeal and conceptual coherence, but the behavioral design undermines its own metaphor — plants that need 'watering' daily breaks the natural logic of growth over time. The craft is meticulous at the component level with consistent visual language, yet the identical pot-and-stem treatment across vastly different habit timescales (0 to 23 days) fails to communicate progress meaningfully, reducing the garden to decoration rather than functional feedback.
